title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
summary: Taking a live call from President Trump on stage, Huang, dressed in his now-signature alligator leather jacket, was handed Apple’s new foldable phone to answer it, a device that isn’t due to hit stores for another five weeks.
